_source: Amyloidosis_MultiPhenotype_Bucket_Config.xlsx, Guardrails sheet (26 rows: 24 parallel routes + 2 DO_NOT_USE). Excel columns preserved verbatim.
_important: Guardrails never become Tier 4 positive evidence; they route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes. DO_NOT_USE rows are audit/provenance only - never screening triggers.

_trigger_basis_key.VERIFIED_ATOM_TAG: sign_id appears in an atom source_workbook_rows array.
_trigger_basis_key.INFERRED_CLINICAL_MATCH: mapped by Feature text to existing atoms; needs_review true.
_trigger_basis_key.INFERRED_TARGET_PHENOTYPE_PATTERN: MULTISYSTEM_COMPOSITE - reuses target phenotype combination rule(s).

guardrails.feature: Female patient with ATTR-like phenotype despite septal wall thickness <12 mm
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Small cohort; exact best threshold needs validation.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.
guardrails.note: Do NOT hardcode a 12mm cutoff in SQL — the source explicitly says not to use a fixed female threshold without sex/body-size-aware LVMI. Trigger condition here is 'recorded_sex=F AND other ATTRwt buckets present', not a numeric wall-thickness comparison.

guardrails.feature: Monoclonal gammopathy / MGUS in an otherwise ATTRwt-like phenotype
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: AL is urgent and must be actively excluded. Presence of monoclonal protein invalidates simple non-invasive ATTR attribution and usually requires definitive typing in the clinical pathway.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Abnormal serum free-light-chain ratio in CKD that may reflect renal clearance rather than monoclonality
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Assay-specific reference ranges matter; true AL can coexist with CKD; immunofixation context remains essential.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Nephrotic-range proteinuria/marked hypoalbuminemia, macroglossia/periorbital purpura, or strong plasma-cell-disorder context
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: MGUS can coexist with ATTRwt, so subtype must remain unresolved until appropriate typing; renal disease can have non-amyloid causes.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Prominent painful polyneuropathy with marked dysautonomia/GI dysfunction ± family history or ocular signs
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: ATTRwt can have some neuropathy/orthostasis, but severe or early autonomic/mixed phenotype shifts toward ATTRv.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Chronic inflammatory/autoinflammatory disease or chronic infection + persistent inflammatory burden + heavy proteinuria
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Older patients may have both degenerative cardiac disease and inflammatory illness; renal cause may remain unresolved.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Mild/well-controlled diabetes that does not explain severe, rapidly progressive or ataxic neuropathy
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Diabetes remains the most common cause of neuropathy and should generally lower specificity.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Active autoimmune disease / positive autoantibodies with a convincing inflammatory/demyelinating neuropathy pattern
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: ATTRv can be misdiagnosed as CIDP and nonspecific autoantibodies may coexist; never use autoimmunity as an exclusion.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Low-flow, low-gradient aortic stenosis
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Severe AS itself causes LVH/low flow; ATTRwt is the stronger TTR subtype association.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.
guardrails.note: Same underlying atoms as WT14 (ATTRwt Tier 2) — as_valve/lflg_as are not tagged with 'V32' in their source_workbook_rows, mapped by clinical description match.

guardrails.feature: Older patient with isolated cardiac ATTR-like phenotype and long orthopedic prodrome but little/no neuropathy or dysautonomia
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Pathogenic TTR variants remain present in a meaningful fraction of elderly ATTR-CM patients, so genetic testing is still necessary.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Biceps tendon rupture, rotator cuff tear, trigger finger/tenosynovitis as an isolated orthopedic prodrome
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Age-related degenerative disease is common; isolated orthopedic pattern without neuropathy/autonomic clues points more toward ATTRwt.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Nephrotic-range proteinuria, macroglossia/periorbital purpura, or strong plasma-cell-disorder context
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: MGUS can coexist with ATTR; no single monoclonal abnormality proves AL.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Chronic inflammatory/autoinflammatory/infectious disease plus new proteinuria/nephrotic renal phenotype
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Inflammatory disease can coexist with unrelated ATTRv; context is probabilistic.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: FMF + proteinuria with possible non-amyloid kidney disease (NAKD)
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Non-amyloid glomerulopathies can coexist with FMF; phenotype cannot replace tissue typing when clinically required.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Heart failure / conduction disease / cardiac imaging abnormalities in a chronic inflammatory patient
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: AL and ATTR are much more important cardiac amyloid subtypes; ordinary cardiac disease is common.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.
guardrails.note: Two possible targets (AL or ATTR) — both reuse-rules are listed; route resolution between them is not specified in the source.

guardrails.feature: Active urinary sediment / hematuria or leukocyturia in an AA-risk patient
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Active sediment may favor glomerulonephritis, infection, stones, or other renal disease and therefore should reduce certainty.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: No identified chronic inflammatory/infectious driver despite adequate longitudinal history
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Occult infection, autoinflammatory disease, malignancy, or inadequately coded inflammatory disease may be missed.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.
guardrails.condition: RENAL bucket gate-eligible AND INFLAMMATORY_DRIVER bucket NOT gate-eligible, despite adequate longitudinal history
guardrails.note: The only guardrail in this set defined by an ABSENCE of evidence rather than a presence pattern.

guardrails.feature: Known monoclonal gammopathy / plasma-cell dyscrasia in a patient with proteinuria or multisystem amyloid-like features
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Monoclonal gammopathy is not synonymous with AL; it also occurs incidentally, especially with age.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Classic ATTR orthopedic prodrome (bilateral/recurrent CTS, lumbar spinal stenosis, distal biceps rupture) followed by cardiac disease
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: CTS/stenosis are common degenerative disorders; they are comparative weights, not exclusions.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Credible chronic inflammatory/autoinflammatory/infectious history + new persistent proteinuria
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: AL and inflammation can coexist; clonal evidence may keep AL active.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Older patient with predominantly isolated cardiac phenotype + AF/CTS and little renal/GI/clonal evidence
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: AL can present cardiac-only; not a hard exclusion.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Painful length-dependent/small-fiber neuropathy with early marked autonomic/GI dysfunction ± hereditary clues
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: AL neuropathy, diabetes and CIDP overlap.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Bilateral/recurrent carpal tunnel syndrome years before cardiac disease
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: CTS is common and can coexist with AL; not an exclusion.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

guardrails.feature: Long orthopedic prodrome: lumbar spinal stenosis / distal biceps rupture / multiple tendon-hand procedures
guardrails.source_guardrail_context: Age-related degenerative disease can mimic individual events.
guardrails.implementation_rule: Never convert to Tier 4 positive evidence; route/flag in parallel and allow simultaneous phenotype passes.

do_not_use.source_guardrail_context: CKD, diuretics, gout, metabolic syndrome and HF commonly elevate uric acid.
Malnutrition, inflammation and liver disease strongly affect prealbumin; low values are not ATTRv-specific.
